products.name: Grant Prospect Report
products.description: One report for one organization and up to three focus areas (or a second state): 25-40 best-fit foundations ranked by grants they made to similar organizations, with recipient, amount, purpose, contact and application instructions from the 990-PF, plus open and forecast federal opportunities that admit nonprofits. HTML + PDF, delivered within 2 business days.

products.name: New-opportunities update
products.description: Monthly re-run of the report: newly filed 990-PFs that add funders for your focus, and new Grants.gov postings and forecasts, with what changed since last month. Cancel any time.

free_sample: The full report is sent free to an organization that replies, before anything is paid for (campaign.sample).
